basis: Severe developmental impairment, seizures, skeletal maturation abnormalities and muscle fiber disproportion; constipation alone does not establish direct bowel damage.
Oxidative phosphorylation disorder; cardiomegaly 9/9, anemia 7/7 and hearing impairment 1/1 assessed. Hearing frequency rests on one patient; elevated CK alone does not establish myopathy.
Progressive skeletal muscular dystrophy; dysphagia reflects muscle involvement. Cardiac and respiratory involvement are absent or uncommon.
Immunodeficiency and characteristic persistent livedo/telangiectases define the syndrome. Respiratory infections do not establish chronic lung damage; bronchiectasis occurs in 2/14.
Transient thyroid hormone deficiency from maternal antithyroid exposure; associated hypotonia, constipation and delayed ossification do not establish lasting extra-thyroid organ damage.
Progressive limb-girdle skeletal muscle weakness and atrophy; cardiac and oculo-facial-bulbar muscles are explicitly spared.
Inherited type 2 diabetes; retinopathy, nephropathy and vascular complications are separately diagnosed diseases.
Embryonal germ cell carcinoma originates in the testis as a reproductive organ, without an endocrine disease component.
Acute necrosis of the renal papillae.
Gestational deficiency of effective vasopressin causes impaired water conservation; polyuria does not imply intrinsic kidney damage.
Central neurodegeneration with parkinsonism and autonomic failure; bladder, bowel and respiratory manifestations reflect neural dysfunction rather than direct damage to those organs.

Primary sarcoma arising in the brain.
Structural prolapse of the aortic valve, potentially causing regurgitation.
Benign tumor originates in the gallbladder, which belongs to the hepatic axis.
Peripheral axonal neuropathy; distal weakness and amyotrophy reflect denervation rather than a separate primary skeletal muscle disease.
Skeletal dysplasia affecting vertebrae, epiphyses, metaphyses and pelvic bones.
PRPH2-related chorioretinal degeneration and atrophy; the neurovascular ancestor does not establish extraocular disease.
Renal malformations and diabetes define RCAD; exocrine pancreatic insufficiency 6/7 and pancreatic atrophy 9/15 support GI involvement. Hepatic injury annotations are mostly below 30%.
Fungal infection; skin/subcutaneous infection and pneumonia each occur in 30-79%. CNS, cardiac and bone infections are occasional; immunodeficiency is a predisposing condition.
Senile plaques are cerebral amyloid-associated neuropathological lesions; no definition or phenotypes support additional organ involvement.
Inherited proline metabolism disorder; many patients are asymptomatic, and neurological manifestations are not established in at least 30% across the umbrella.
Malignant notochordal tumor arising in the axial skeleton; neurological compression varies by site and is not established in at least 30% across the group.
Skeletal overgrowth syndrome with scoliosis, osteopenia, macrodactyly and epiphyseal dysplasia; no endocrine gland disorder is established.
Ulcerative inflammation of the eyelid margins is characteristically bacterial, usually staphylococcal.
